verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests a basic electrical wiring-plan artifact as a first-step design deliverable.
The client changes the artifact acceptance condition from a basic wiring plan to a finalized wiring plan; updating the existing deliverable key leaves no stale attribute.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim that the wiring-overview artifact has been saved with the project documentation.
The client approves suitable bowl accent LEDs but does not require their inclusion in or modification of the wiring-plan artifact.
The source specifies visual recreation and lighting around the power button, not a change to the wiring-plan artifact.
